Get or set the default visual variant

Source: R/i18n.R
lap_variant.Rd

Resolves the light/dark variant used by theme_lapidary() and the plot builders when variant is not given explicitly. Reads the lapidary.variant option or LAPIDARY_VARIANT environment variable, falling back to "light". The dark-first counterpart of lap_lang().

Usage

lap_variant(variant = NULL)

Arguments

variant

Optional variant to validate and return; NULL (default) returns the configured default.

Value

A single valid variant string.

Examples

lap_variant()
#> [1] "light"
old <- options(lapidary.variant = "dark")
lap_variant()
#> [1] "dark"
options(old)
